description: This is a localization or translation file containing Norwegian language strings for a chat application. It defines UI text, functions for dynamic strings, and references to external components like SubmitKey.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Generates input hint text based on the submit key, with additional instructions if the key is Enter.

methods.name: Update.Version
methods.description: Returns a string showing the current version.

methods.name: Update.FoundUpdate
methods.description: Returns a string indicating a new version has been found.

methods.name: Usage.SubTitle
methods.description: Displays the amount of used and total account balance.

methods.name: Prompt.History
methods.description: Creates a summary prompt for chat history.

methods.name: Prompt.Topic
methods.description: Creates a prompt to generate a short title summarizing the conversation.

methods.name: Prompt.Summarize
methods.description: Creates a prompt to summarize the discussion in 200 words or less.
